title: The Sermon on the Mount
introduction: The Sermon on the Mount (Matthew 5–7) is Jesus' most famous speech and contains the core of his ethical teaching. Here we find the Beatitudes, the Lord's Prayer, and radical calls to a life marked by love, humility, and trust in God.

sections.title: The Beatitudes
sections.description: Jesus blesses those whom the world often overlooks—the poor in spirit, those who mourn, the humble.

sections.title: Salt and Light
sections.description: Jesus' disciples are called to be salt and light in the world.

sections.title: The Law Fulfilled
sections.description: Jesus did not come to abolish the law but to fulfill it—with a deeper demand.

sections.title: Love Your Enemies
sections.description: The radical command to love even those who persecute us.

sections.title: Do Not Worry
sections.description: Jesus calls us to trust rather than worry.

sections.title: The Golden Rule
sections.description: The summary of the Law and the Prophets in one sentence.

sections.title: Building on the Rock
sections.description: The one who hears and does Jesus' words builds their life on a solid foundation.
